items.title: Justin Sun seeks sanctions against Trump-linked World Liberty Financial over UAE ties
items.summary: The Tron founder says World Liberty failed to disclose its UAE ties until months into his lawsuit over $45 million in WLFI tokens.

items.title: South Korea's president says country needs a ‘cybersecurity czar’ following $6.3 billion Binance hack
items.summary: Lee Jae Myung said he wants a government-wide agency to tackle cyberattacks as AI raises security concerns across financial institutions and critical infrastructure.

items.title: Amazon, Tesla and SpaceX join OKX–ICE tokenized stock objections as deadline looms
items.summary: Objections have reached 56 companies, with nearly 80% of the venture’s initial stock selection opting out.

items.title: Stablecoin governance group behind OUSD sets out management fee, offers equity earning pool
items.summary: Governance group Open Standard will charge a 0.1 basis point management fee on payment volume, capped at at $0.01 per payment.

items.title: CFTC clears perpetual futures on stocks, bringing crypto trading model to Wall Street
items.summary: CFTC Chair Michael Selig said the move gives U.S. traders a regulated alternative to “offshore, and often unregulated, venues.”

items.title: Binance's $6.3 billion hack began with a fake job interview, and a campaign 'built over many months'
items.summary: North Korea-linked attackers spent months compromising Binance employees and internal systems before exploiting its hot-wallet signing infrastructure through Ethereum's EIP-7702 mechanism.

items.title: South Korea asks its biggest banks how a major crypto hack would hit them
items.summary: In its first such survey, the BOK also asked about a crypto price crash, losses at another firm, and each firm’s crypto teams, budgets and investments.

items.title: CZ warns of more AI-driven hacks following Binance’s historic $6.3 billion heist
items.summary: While investigators found no evidence that AI agents laundered the stolen Binance funds, Zhao stressed that automated tools are lowering the barrier for complex breaches.

items.title: LO:TECH raises $12 million to expand crypto trading into U.S. and Asia
items.summary: LO:TECH is betting on round-the-clock tokenized stock trading but didn’t say if it trades them now; a WFE study found stock exchanges still set prices.

items.title: Binance net outflows reach $5.3 billion after record hack. CEO says recovery underway
items.summary: Nearly $11 billion left the exchange over 46 hours, although CEO Richard Teng said hourly deposits were beginning to exceed withdrawals.

items.title: Wall Street killed Bitcoin’s wild rallies: 10x’s Markus Thielen
items.summary: Markus Thielen sees Bitcoin reaching $90,000 by year-end, questions institutional ETF demand and says Ethereum must do more for holders.

items.title: Binance traces $6.3B hack to fake job interviews, compromised AI tool
items.summary: Hackers exploited compromised employee computers and stolen credentials to breach Binance’s wallet infrastructure, according to the exchange’s investigation.

items.title: Bitcoin price defends $76K lows as analysts see stocks pricing in ‘political gridlock’
items.summary: Bitcoin made modest gains at the start of Wall Street trading on Tuesday as markets awaited cues from the US midterm elections.

items.title: What’s at stake for crypto as the US votes in the 2026 midterms?
items.summary: Crypto groups spent about $176 million ahead of the US midterms, with control of Congress and the future of crypto legislation at stake.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Moscow Exchange to launch Bitcoin, Ether and USDT trading in December
items.summary: Moscow Exchange plans to launch crypto trading on Dec. 1 under Russia’s new law, with annual purchase limits for non-qualified investors.

items.title: NEAR token sinks 7% as proposal to cut annual token issuance passes
items.summary: The proposed issuance cut would prevent 11.8 million NEAR from entering circulation over two years, worth about $45 million at today’s price.

items.title: Binance’s net inflows turn positive at $2.3B as withdrawals expand
items.summary: Binance led exchanges in 24-hour net inflows, reversing Monday’s heavy outflows as it restored access to funds after its $6.3 billion hack.

items.title: France postpones 2027 budget vote, crypto exit-tax proposals scrapped
items.summary: The National Assembly postponed the vote on the budget’s revenue section for the second time, while the Nov. 17 deadline for the first reading examination nears.

items.title: Bitcoin price threatens $77.7K support loss with recent buyers underwater
items.summary: Bitcoin fell below the realized price of the one-to-three-month-old buyer cohort in a move that risked flipping it to new resistance.

items.title: Brazil's Biggest Bitcoin Exchange Says It Will Refund Users After a $40 Million Hack
items.summary: Mercado Bitcoin says customers won't pay for a hack that drained tens of millions. Withdrawals on the exchange remain frozen with no restart date.

items.title: Elon Musk’s Tesla and SpaceX Block Their Stock From OKX-ICE Tokenized Venue
items.summary: Amazon, Tesla, SpaceX, Netflix, Lam Research, and SoFi objected to trading of their shares on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, bringing the total to 56.

items.title: Five Ways North Korea Breaks Into Crypto Firms—and How Binance Was Hacked
items.summary: From AI deepfakes to poisoning code libraries: here's how North Korean hackers get inside crypto companies.

items.title: Epidemic of Hacked Freezers Spreads Across Europe
items.summary: A suspected hacking wave has pushed supermarket freezers into defrost mode across ten European countries, with temperatures reportedly hitting 50°C. Nobody knows who's behind it or why it spread.

items.title: UK Says AI-Powered Ransomware Attack on Critical Infrastructure 'Highly Likely' by 2028
items.summary: The National Cyber Security Centre said AI will expose security flaws "tolerated for far too long," and called time on "tech on the cheap."

items.title: Ethereum Privacy Network Aztec Rolls Out Major Security and Speed Upgrade
items.summary: The “Tierra” upgrade resolves a critical bug from the prior version, adds formal verification, and an AI-powered testing harness.

items.title: Morning Minute: Tom Lee Calls the Binance Hack Bullish for Ethereum
items.summary: Meanwhile, both the BTC ETFs and ETH ETFs bleed outflows in the Binance hack aftermath, dragging down prices.

items.title: Binance Misses Monthly Luna Classic Burn for First Time Since 2023
items.summary: LUNC holders are waiting for Binance’s November burn, but it hasn’t arrived as the exchange recovers from a record $6.3 billion hack.

items.title: Liquid Network Restores Full Bitcoin Backing Two Months After $320M Exploit
items.summary: Blockstream CEO Adam Back said the sidechain's defenses have been hardened, and warned developers not to trust AI-suggested fixes blindly.

items.title: North Korea Denies $6.3B Binance Hack, Calls FBI Finding a 'Political Provocation'
items.summary: Kim Yo Jong suggested the U.S. itself could be behind the theft, as Binance said hourly deposits had begun to exceed withdrawals.
